notes:
What's new in 0.1.130:
- Keep me signed in: this PC now tells beebo.tv, for each person in your home, whether a phone signed in away from home may keep that person signed in, using the same rule as signing in on this PC (never a guest or a profile with parental limits). beebo.tv now starts a new kept sign-in only with this PC's yes, so update this PC to keep "Keep me signed in" working for new sign-ins on phones away from home. If you add parental limits to a profile, this PC sends the change straight away and that person's phones are no longer kept signed in; phones need the app 1.78 or newer to follow that change.
- Backup: a file in the safety-copy folder that is hard-linked to another file is no longer offered as a safety copy to restore, and while such a file is there, no old safety copies are deleted.
- Cast from the browser player: pressing Cancel in the Cast device list no longer shows the "No TV found" message, and in a browser without Google Cast support (for example Safari or Firefox) the Cast button no longer tries to load Google's Cast script and goes straight to the browser's own cast option.
- Windows only. The phone app and Beebo Auto are separate releases.
- Automated checks: the Keep me signed in and backup changes were tested on the Windows desktop test files they touch, in two runs of 57 and 355 files, and all passed (one timing-sensitive file failed once while two test runs shared the computer and passed when run alone); the Cast change passed all 182 tests in its 5 player and Cast test files. The Keep me signed in and backup changes each had two clear code reviews (they touch sign-in and deleting files) and the Cast change one. The signed installer passed its signature, size, converter, connection-helper and language checks. The full Windows desktop test suite was not run on this release, and no person has installed this version or tried its in-app update yet.
- Release source commit 238c40ffe.
